title: sse: introduce span-resolver and semaphore-flush to stabilize partial JSON and ordered toolcall handoff
author: Asha Menon
merge_outcome: Merged after green CI and +2 approvals; small follow-up hotfix queued
description: Motivation: Live SSE streams sometimes emitted delimiter tokens that split structured JSON spans and reordered tool/function call sentinel boundaries under high-concurrency prefix-merge scenarios. This resulted in partial JSON objects reaching clients and occasional toolcall ordinal inversion when late-arriving fragments were applied. This PR introduces two coordinated mitigations: 1) a Span Resolver that tracks logical JSON/structured-output spans across chunk boundaries and emits explicit endcap markers to guarantee atomic span delivery, and 2) a per-stream Semaphore Flush that enforces an ordered drain/flush point before switching handoff to function/tool callers. Summary of changes: add sse/span_resolver module with deterministic span ID assignment and reassembly checkpoints; implement endcap markers ("__span_end:<id>__") emitted only when a span is fully reassembled; introduce semaphore-based flush/handshake in sse/stream_coordinator to serialize toolcall handoffs and prevent ordinal inversion; add a lookahead delimiter probe to avoid splitting UTF-8 multibyte sequences across chunk boundaries; add backwards-compatible compatibility layer that strips internal endcap markers when running in openai-compat mode; tests: comprehensive unit/integration set covering fragmented JSON reassembly, racey toolcall handoff, and roundtrip compatibility with older clients. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag sse.span_resolver.enabled (default off). Canary deploy to edge region us-west-2 for 48 hours with traffic shaping; flip global runtime flag after canary metrics show <1% elevated latency and 0 regression in structured-output acceptance tests. Backwards compatibility: openai-compat mode removes internal endcap markers so clients that expect vanilla SSE semantics see original stream. Related work: builds on ENG-12011 (previous checkpointing experiment) and implements learnings from incident SUP-4821. Notes on cost and perf: semaphore flush introduces a small serialization point when a toolcall is actively being handed off; we added batching windows to amortize overhead and measured median token latency increase of ~2.3ms in stress tests but eliminated 100% of observed partial-JSON incidents. CI and testing: added deterministic fragment-replay harness and fuzzing job for SSE chunk permutations. Documentation: runtime flag, migration notes, and compatibility guidance added to docs/sse_streaming.md.

review_conversation: Diego Ramos: Generally LGTM but please add a comment documenting the invariants for span IDs and GC behavior.
Asha Menon: Added detailed doc comments in span_resolver.rs and a small GC test that exercises long-running spans.
Katherine Liu: Found a race when multiple toolcalls were queued for the same connection; suggested an explicit queue drain before handshake. Implemented queue drain and added test.

Diego Ramos: Approving after fixes and CI green.
release_notes: Fixes an issue where SSE streaming could emit partial/unterminated JSON objects and reorder tool/function call boundaries under high-concurrency fragmentation. Adds a span resolver and handshake semantics to ensure atomic structured-output spans and deterministic toolcall ordering. Backwards-compatible in openai-compat mode.
testing_notes: New deterministic fragment replay harness included. Run 'cargo test --manifest-path runtime/Cargo.toml --features=sse' plus the fragment_replay_test locally. Fuzzer: ci/fuzzers/sse_fuzzer.yml. Canary plan described in description.
observability_notes: Added metrics: sse.span_reassembled_count, sse.endcap_emitted_count, sse.semaphore_flush_wait_ms (p99). Dashboard tile added to Runtime > SSE Streams.
follow_up: PR queued: hotfix to strip endcap markers in a stricter set of compatibility configurations (coming from canary feedback). See ENG-12902.
notes_for_ops: When enabling the runtime flag globally, monitor sse.endcap_emitted_count and sse.partial_json_error_rate. If partial_json_error_rate spikes, rollback and gather fragment replay logs for region.
client_impact: OpenAI-compat clients: no visible change. New clients can use explicit span markers to correlate structured output. SDK examples updated.
changelog_entry: sse: robust span reassembly and ordered toolcall handoff (span-resolver + semaphore flush)
